documents.body: Expired worker leases reject future dispatch. Cancellation retains the slot because a background thread can still run. Never assume an expired token cancels a remote call.
Unknown inference responses keep the original reservation. Reconcile provider billing before releasing reserved micro USD. Do not retry an ambiguous paid request.
FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY prevents tenant leaks. Application roles must not own tables or use BYPASSRLS. Set the tenant transaction variable before querying.
Build 17 failed because the application returned HTTP 503. The verified deployment digest is sha256:abc. A later successful build does not change this failure.
Rollback requires approval of the exact resource version and image digest. Check Kubernetes object UID, health window and schema compatibility before reverting.
队列积压时检查消费者容量与租户并发上限。持续等待并不代表消息丢失。确认下游健康后逐步增加消费者。
Approval is bound to the action payload digest and expires at a fixed deadline. A revoked resource grant blocks dispatch even with an old approved decision.
Webhook HMAC signatures and timestamp windows guard ingestion. Inbox deduplicates delivery IDs. A notification triggers authoritative reconciliation, never direct success.
SSE resumes from the last event sequence. The server rechecks grants while streaming. HTTP header latency is not the duration of the entire event stream.

def calculate_refund(amount, fee):
    """Refund subtracts a processing fee exactly once."""
    return max(0, amount - fee)
